layers.note: A tall perennial herb of the herb layer.

moisture.note: Colonises open, disturbed ground across most moisture levels; scarce on waterlogged soil.

heat_load.note: Grows on every aspect in the open.

max_slope_deg.note: Colonises slides and steep, raw slopes.

shade_tolerance.note: Very intolerant of shade: abundant after fire or clearing and fading as the canopy closes.

provenance.notes: Authored from general knowledge of the species in western Washington lowland forests; not yet checked against Silvics of North America (Burns and Honkala, 1990) or the Fire Effects Information System, both public-domain USDA Forest Service works.
